mask_kind: Binary polygon spatial selection intersected with matching tee alpha>0. Every selected RGBA pixel copied verbatim from original base. No feather.
mirroring: Apply the same whole-group mirror transform as the base and all other garment layers
purpose: Restore original pink handlebar grip and adjacent foreground forearm over the fitted tee; preserve cuff opening while leaving the tee independent

qa.manual_cuff_check: Cuff edge remains intact at gameplay size; green overlap is removed from grip, and original forearm continues into grip without a floating fabric strip

minimum_scope: Exclude every pixel outside the polygon or where the tee contributes zero alpha, avoiding double-compositing unrelated semi-transparent original pixels
